name: @supersuit/gv-identity
description: The one verifier for the gv_id cookie, the shared garysheng.com sign-in: a compact JWS (ES256, P-256) that says who someone is and never what they may open. Web Crypto only, so it runs in Next.js server routes, middleware and Edge.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/check-dist.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
